mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, session_no, status, boundary_reason, started_at, last_active_at, closed_at, message_count, user_message_count, ai_message_count, merchant_message_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mt_im_conversation_session WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM mt_im_conversation_session WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY session_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mt_im_conversation_session SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = #{closedAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE mt_im_conversation_session SET message_count = message_count + 1, user_message_count = user_message_count + IF(#{senderRole} = 'USER', 1, 0), ai_message_count = ai_message_count + IF(#{senderRole} = 'AI', 1, 0), merchant_message_count = merchant_message_count + IF(#{senderRole} = 'MERCHANT', 1, 0), last_active_at = GREATEST(last_active_at, #{eventTime}), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
